text: 下周最重要的数据发布将是周三公布的美国7月CPI报告，随后周四将公布PPI数据。德意志银行美国经济学家预计，整体消费者价格环比上涨0.15%，6月为下降0.42%；核心CPI预计环比上涨0.26%，与6月持平。对于PPI数据，预计整体PPI环比上涨0.22%（此前为0.13%）。
text_en: The most important data release next week will be Wednesday's U.S. July CPI report, followed by PPI data on Thursday. Deutsche Bank U.S. economists expect headline CPI to rise 0.15% month-over-month, versus a 0.42% decline in June; core CPI is forecast to rise 0.26% month-over-month, flat with June. For PPI, they expect headline PPI to rise 0.22% month-over-month (prior 0.13%).
